summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K to furnish a press release disclosing its management estimate of net asset value (NAV) as of June 30, 2026, at $183.1 million (94% increase from prior NAV). The filing does not announce a transaction, business combination, or material definitive agreement. It is an operational update on NAV and fleet status. No special situation is triggered; the report is a routine disclosure under Rule 13a-16.
